verdict.rationale: Gemini API is inherently a headless REST/SDK service with official Python, JS/TS, Go, and Java SDKs plus REST endpoints, batch processing for large async jobs, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints — all of which are naturally scriptable in CI/automation pipelines without any UI dependency. Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow docs) or independent hands-on reports of running it in automated build pipelines.
